resources.string: Every voice here is your phone\'s own speech engine. The packs differ only by pitch, speaking rate and which installed voice the phone picks for them, so on some phones two packs can sound much alike. The names are characters.
Choosing a voice also chooses the words it speaks. It decides from the next ring: an alarm already ringing keeps its voice.

Hear plays the line on the alarm stream, at the loudness a ring of this profile would use, as loud as your alarm volume is set now. It plays without the alarm tone, and it does not raise the volume, as a ring does if you agreed to that.
No voice is chosen for this profile, so its alarms use the phone\'s default voice.

Extra loudness on top of what the alert intensity dial sets, for this voice on every profile that uses it. A limiter keeps the peaks in check, so the higher steps can add less than they say, and on some lines little.
That could not be saved. What is shown is what is stored.
An alarm is ringing, and it comes first. Try again when it is over.
This phone has no speech voice installed that works offline, so nothing can be said. A ring would still sound its tone and show its words. You can add a voice in Android\'s text-to-speech settings.
You asked for speech only through a headset, and none can be used. Connect one to hear it.
The phone\'s speech engine did not answer. A ring would still sound its tone and show its words.
The line could not be played. A ring would still sound its tone and show its words.
